problems.title: Two roots of a rational equation
problems.question: Solve $(x+3)/x+x/(x-2)=5$.
problems.idea: Exclude zero denominators and clear the fractions.
formulas: Domain: x≠0,2; multiplying by x(x-2) is valid on that domain.
steps: The roots 2/3 and 3 are both allowed.

problems.title: A quadratic can become a linear equation
problems.question: For which a does (a+1)x²-2ax+a-3=0 have exactly one distinct real root?
problems.idea: Check the zero leading coefficient separately from the discriminant.
formulas: For A≠0, a quadratic has one real root iff D=B²-4AC=0.
steps: If a=-1, the equation is 2x-4=0, with one root x=2.
Setting D=0 gives a=-3/2, whose leading coefficient is nonzero.

problems.title: Subtract one worker’s rate
problems.question: Two workers together finish in 3 hours; the first alone takes 4 hours. Find the second worker’s solo time.
problems.idea: Completion rates add.
steps: The second rate is 1/3-1/4=1/12 job per hour.
A full job therefore takes 12 hours.

problems.title: Cosine of the smallest angle
problems.question: A right triangle’s legs are in ratio 3:2. Find the cosine of its smallest angle.
problems.idea: The smallest angle lies opposite the shorter leg.
formulas: Hypotenuse²=sum of squared legs; cosθ=adjacent leg/hypotenuse.
steps: Write the legs as 3t and 2t. The hypotenuse is √13t.
For the angle opposite 2t, the adjacent leg is 3t.

problems.title: The incenter divides the symmetry altitude
problems.question: An isosceles triangle has base 2.4 cm and equal sides 6 cm. In what ratio does its incenter divide the altitude to the base?
problems.idea: Use area divided by semiperimeter for the inradius.
steps: Let the altitude be h, its base foot D, apex A and incenter I.
problems.answer: AI:ID=5:1; from the base toward the apex, ID:IA=1:5.
problems.note: The printed choice 1:5 uses the base-first order. The original question does not explicitly state the ratio’s direction.

problems.title: A scaled 3-4-5 right triangle
problems.question: A right triangle has tanα=3/4 and hypotenuse 1.5 cm. Find its inradius.
problems.idea: The tangent ratio gives the familiar 3:4:5 side ratio.

problems.title: Sine from three side lengths
problems.question: A triangle has sides 2,3,4 cm. Find the sine of its smallest angle.
problems.idea: Use the cosine rule for the angle opposite side 2.
steps: The smallest angle A is opposite 2.

problems.title: A parameter is also a root
problems.question: For which a does 2ax²-x-a=0 have x=a as a root?
problems.idea: Substitute x=a and solve the resulting equation in a.
formulas: A specified root must make the polynomial zero.
steps: The values a=0,1,-1 all work; at a=0 the equation is linear but still has root zero.

problems.title: A 120-degree isosceles triangle
problems.question: An isosceles triangle has apex angle 120°. Find base/equal side.
problems.idea: The altitude splits the apex angle and base in half.
steps: If the equal side is s and base b, then b/2=s·sin60°=s√3/2.

problems.title: Solve a trigonometric identity condition
problems.question: If cos²α+tan²α=1, find cosα.
problems.idea: Replace tan²α by sin²α/cos²α, noting cosα≠0.

problems.title: All three angles must be acute
problems.question: For which x is the triangle with sides 3,4,x acute?
problems.idea: Every side’s square must be less than the sum of the other two squared.
formulas: An acute triangle satisfies a²<b²+c² for each side.
steps: The condition for side x is x²<3²+4²=25, so x<5.
The condition for side 4 is 16<9+x², so x>√7.
The condition for side 3 is automatic, and this interval also satisfies the triangle inequality.

problems.title: Parallelogram law with a diagonal ratio
problems.question: A parallelogram has sides 6 and 8 cm and diagonals in ratio 1:2. Find the sum of its diagonals.
problems.idea: Use the sum of squared diagonal lengths.
steps: Write the diagonals as t and 2t.

problems.title: Perpendicular medians and the centroid
problems.question: Two perpendicular medians have lengths 9 and 12 cm. Find the third median.
problems.idea: The centroid divides each median in ratio 2:1, and its three vertex vectors sum to zero.
formulas: Vertex-to-centroid distance=2/3 of the median; perpendicular vector lengths obey Pythagoras.
steps: The two vertex-to-centroid segments have lengths 6 and 8 and are perpendicular.
The third vertex vector is the negative of their sum, so its length is √(6²+8²)=10.
problems.note: This uses 9 and 12 as the median lengths, the intended reading supported by the choices.

problems.title: A substituted quadratic with a restricted range
problems.question: The roots of t²+mt+n=0 are -1,-2. How many real roots has (x²-2x)²+m(x²-2x)+n=0?
problems.idea: The substituted expression cannot be smaller than -1.
steps: The new equation requires x²-2x=-1 or -2.
The value -1 gives (x-1)²=0, so x=1 is the only distinct root.

problems.title: A zero factor makes a trigonometric product simple
problems.question: Evaluate $(\tan45^\circ+\cot120^\circ)(\sin120^\circ+\cos150^\circ)$.
problems.idea: Compute the second factor first.
steps: The first factor is defined because sin120°≠0.
A finite number multiplied by zero is zero.

problems.title: Small diagonal of a rhombus
problems.question: A rhombus has obtuse angle 150° and perimeter 6 cm. Find its smaller diagonal.
problems.idea: Use its side and acute angle 30°.
steps: The acute angle is 30°, with cos30°=√3/2.

problems.title: Recover both diagonals of a rhombus
problems.question: A rhombus has perimeter 52 cm and diagonal sum 34 cm. Find the larger diagonal.
problems.idea: The half-diagonals form a right triangle with a side.
steps: The side is s=13, so d₁²+d₂²=676.

problems.title: Magnitude of a difference from squares and a product
problems.question: If x²+y²=6¼ and xy=-3, find |x-y|.
problems.idea: Square the desired difference.
steps: The absolute difference is its nonnegative square root.

problems.title: A biquadratic has one positive squared root
problems.question: How many distinct real roots has x⁴+bx²-b²=0, where b≠0?
problems.idea: Set t=x² and use the sign of the product of its roots.
formulas: For t²+bt-b²=0, the root product is -b²<0.
steps: The t-equation has two real roots of opposite signs, because its discriminant is 5b²>0.
Only the positive t-root can equal x².
That positive value produces two distinct real x-roots, ±√t.

problems.title: A zero product restricts one coordinate
problems.question: If (x+9)(y-9)=0, find the least possible value of x²+y².
problems.idea: At least one coordinate is forced to have magnitude 9.
formulas: A square is nonnegative; a zero product has a zero factor.
steps: Either x=-9 or y=9. In either case x²+y²≥81.

problems.title: Area increase after enlarging a square
problems.question: Increasing a square’s side by 3 cm increases its area by 39 cm². Find the new area.
problems.idea: Set the difference of the two squares equal to 39.

problems.title: Difference of reciprocal fractions from their sum
problems.question: A fraction’s numerator is one less than its denominator. Its sum with its reciprocal is 2.05. Find their absolute difference.
problems.idea: Use the sum-square identity; the product of reciprocal fractions is 1.
steps: Taking the nonnegative square root gives |u-v|=9/20=0.45.

problems.title: Meeting after one car turns around
problems.question: Two cars leave Tbilisi for Kutaisi, 240 km away, with speeds in ratio 7:5. The faster reaches Kutaisi and immediately returns. How far from Kutaisi do they meet?
problems.idea: Their travelled distances share the same ratio because the elapsed time is equal.
steps: Let the meeting point be d km from Kutaisi.
The faster car travels 240+d; the slower travels 240-d.

problems.title: An absolute-value function at a squared input
problems.question: Solve f(a²-2)=4a if f(x)=|x+5|.
problems.idea: The expression inside the absolute value is always positive.
steps: Both a=1 and a=3 satisfy the original equation.

problems.title: Factor a quadratic with a parameter
problems.question: Solve x²-px=2x.
problems.idea: Factor x instead of dividing by it.
steps: When p=-2, these coincide and there is only one distinct root.
